# Cync Digital

> Portfolio and working practice of Naimur Rahman Ferdous — an affiliate, partnerships, and business development practitioner actively interviewing for full-time roles.

Cync Digital showcases real, hands-on work: partner program builds, deal sourcing and negotiation, commission-structure design (CPA/RevShare/Hybrid), and reporting systems. It is a self-directed practice, not an agency taking on client work.
